name: Jackson Street Bridge
description: The postcard downtown skyline view, framed by Freedom Parkway below.
tips: Shoot from the north sidewalk so the skyline sits behind you
Arrive 40 minutes before sunset; it is busy and the light goes fast
A longer lens compresses the towers and hides the traffic

name: Krog Street Tunnel
description: Ever-changing graffiti tunnel between Inman Park and Cabbagetown.
tips: The art is repainted constantly, so scout the wall before posing
Light is flat inside: stand near a tunnel mouth for a soft key light
Watch for cars; it is a live roadway

name: Ponce City Market Rooftop
description: Skyline Park on the roof, with midtown and downtown both in frame.
tips: Paid entry and it closes early on some nights; check before you go
The carnival lights read well once the sky turns blue
Shoot from the west rail for the midtown skyline

name: Piedmont Park, Oak Hill
description: Open lawn with the full midtown skyline across Lake Clara Meer.
tips: Stand on the rise so the skyline clears the treeline
Backlight at sunset and expose for the face, not the sky
The dock gives you the skyline reflected in the lake

name: BeltLine Eastside Trail murals
description: A continuous run of large-format murals along the Eastside Trail.
tips: Walk the stretch between Irwin St and Ponce for the densest wall art
Busy with cyclists: step well off the path before you set up
Plain mural walls make clean, uncluttered backgrounds

name: Wylie Street murals, Cabbagetown
description: The Forward Warrior wall: a long block of commissioned murals.
tips: It is a residential street, so keep the noise down
Afternoon light rakes across the wall and brings out the texture
Shoot tight to isolate one mural per frame

name: Centennial Olympic Park
description: Fountain of Rings with the downtown towers behind it.
tips: The fountain runs on a schedule; the rings light up after dark
Crouch low to catch the water arcs at eye level
Very busy on weekends

name: Historic Oakland Cemetery
description: Victorian memorial grounds with the downtown skyline rising behind them.
tips: The skyline shows best from the western ridge near Bell Tower
Respect the grounds; it is an active cemetery with posted photo rules
Soft hedges and stone make for calm, uncluttered backgrounds

name: Atlanta Botanical Garden
description: Canopy walk and planted beds, dense green backgrounds year round.
tips: Ticketed entry; tripods are restricted, so plan on handheld
The Canopy Walk gives even, open shade at midday
Greenery reads best on an overcast day

name: Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park
description: Sweet Auburn: the birth home, Ebenezer Baptist Church, and the reflecting pool.
tips: Go early; it is quiet before the tour groups arrive
The reflecting pool gives a clean mirrored background
Be mindful that this is a memorial site, not a backdrop

name: Emory University Quadrangle
description: Marble-clad academic buildings around an open lawn.
tips: The pale marble bounces soft light onto faces late in the day
Arches on the east side frame a subject cleanly
Quiet on weekends

name: Historic Fourth Ward Park
description: Terraced lake basin and a skate bowl, right off the BeltLine.
tips: The amphitheatre steps give you clean geometric lines
Skate bowl concrete is a plain, modern background
The lake catches the skyline at the south end
